spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** Two profound arcana are disclosed through divine love and wisdom — its influx into the mind and its withdrawal. At the moment when divine wisdom flows in and becomes manifest throughout the whole of the mind, all natural affections rouse themselves from spiritual torpor toward the splendor of that wisdom, and open the interiors of the mind to receive it. But when divine perception withdraws from the mind's awareness, all thoughts in every region of the understanding, and even all affections of the will, retreat into obscure states of falsity. The whole mind closes its interiors, and the state of falsity from evil overcomes it. All things of thought and affection remain confined within that spiritual darkness in their states of concealment.

---

**¶3:** Exceedingly great is this arcanum revealed through divine wisdom! For when divine truth flows in and becomes manifest at the first state of illumination, all the interiors of the mind open, and every faculty of thought and every affection descends into the external natural mind — there to assault the Divine Good and Truth that stands fixed in a state of patient silence within the natural plane.

---

**¶4:** This pertains to the arcanum of the Primordial Celestial Human, because when that divine principle proceeded from the Infinite itself, it shone forth over all the states of falsity from evil. At that moment all falsities from evil came forth from their interior repositories — organized evils and marshaled falsities — abandoning their deepest hells and their abyssal states of profanity. They devastated the [GAP-1: the exposed exterior truths constituting] the outward form of the five faculties of celestial perception, which were the protective truths enveloping the Divine Human's external nature, in that first state of spiritual combat.

---

**¶5:** Again, when divine perception withdraws from the mind's awareness and sets, and all thoughts retreat into their states of obscurity and conceal themselves — this also pertains to the arcanum of the final consummation: it prefigures the ultimate completion of all spiritual states. For when all wisdom and truth have been fully separated from falsity and liberated throughout the whole mind at the last, the gathering principle of all regenerate goods — the Ultimate Divine Human Form — will collect all truths and goods and compose itself into one perfect likeness. It is the final state of the church's spiritual day, the time when the Ultimate Divine Human Form will ascend into the eternal state of divine love and wisdom. The adversary also — spiritual death itself — will be confined to bondage: to the infernal state appointed for those who denied and profaned the Divine, who loved falsity and evil. They will enter with it into that confinement, and the state of utter falsity from evil overcomes them; and thenceforth the very quality called "wisdom" will never illuminate them again.

---

**¶6:** Behold the two arcana made manifest perpetually through divine love — which is the resplendent source of all spiritual illumination.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Two great mysteries are apparent in this shining sun, at its rising and setting. Now, at the moment when it rises and is visible in the universe, all creatures of flesh shall lift up their heads fr[om their sleep] towards the splendour of the sun, and open their doors. While at evening time, when the sun sinks from the universe, all people from every place and even all beasts shall go in to their dark hiding places. The population of the entire universe shuts their doors and dark night overcomes them. They go inside and stay within the dark night in their hiding places.

Very great is this mystery revealed by the sun! For when the sun rises and [be]come[s] visible at the beginning of the day all people open their doors, and all of humanity and every creature emerges onto the ear[th] to destroy this Light Cross that is established i[n] silence.

This pertains to the mystery of the First Man, because when he came out from the grea[t]ness he shone forth over all the children of Darkness. At that mome[nt] all the children of Darkness came forth from their storehouses, its powers and its armies, abandoning their caves and their black abyss. They destroyed the [outer] body of his five sons, who were swathed over hi[s b]o[dy, in t]hat first struggle.

Again, when the sun sinks from the universe and sets, and all people go in to their hiding places and houses and conceal themselves; this also pertains to the mystery of the end, as it presages the consummation of the universe. For, when all the light will be purified and redeemed i[n] the universe at the last, the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt it/self. It is the last hour of the day, the time when the Last Statue will go up to the aeo[n of] light. The enemy too, death, will go in to bondage; to the prison of the souls of the de[ni]iers and blasphemers who loved the darkness. They will go in with it to bondage and the dark night overcomes th[em]; and thenceforth this name 'light' will not shine upon them.
Behold the two mysteries made visible daily in the sun, which is this splendrous light-giver.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading specifies "exposed exterior truths constituting the outward form," and in Manichaean cosmology the five sons (light elements) formed the First Man's outer armor that was devoured by darkness in the first battle; "outer" accurately renders this exposed, external quality in the Kephalaia's natural-plane vocabulary.
